raw: {"verdict": "pass", "reason": "declineOffer row-locks the entry with FOR UPDATE, so double taps and two-process races decline only once. It cancels the entry so the link is dead and the client isn't re-offered, releases only its own hold, and calls offerFreedSlot so the next client is offered immediately. An already-claimed offer no longer has status 'offered', so declining it does nothing. I couldn't see offerFreedSlot, expireOffer or acceptOffer, so this assumes their behaviour."}
